Learned counsel argued that without any material on record, the investigating officer has filed the charge-sheet implicating the present applicant of commission of offence of rape punishable under Section 376 of Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the bail application, but could not show any satisfactory material from which it could be inferred that forceful sexual assault was committed upon the prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant also opposed the bail application.

5. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and upon perusal of the charge-sheet, this Court is of the prima-facie view that no forceful sexual assault has been committed upon the prosecutrix and the possibility that the relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix was that of consent cannot be ruled out.
6.

In view of the aforesaid, this Court deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused-applicant under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
7.

The applicant Harish Kumar S/o Madanlal arrested in connection with the FIR No. 396/2023 registered at Police Station Sanchor, District Jalore shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
8. Applicant shall be required to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
